experiment: exact-state weekly incremental PCA-IV candidate replay
selection: up to ten locally validated finite-neighbourhood candidates with the largest minimum of the multiplicity-adjusted direct-P and importance-weighted validation mean lower bounds
continuation_law: independent five-daily-step matrix-exponential continuations under the fitted physical PCA-IV law from each identical state
contract_timing: fixed cash strikes; options expiring within the week settle at their exact expiry, while all other options are repriced after five daily steps
